title: best smart watch to use as collector?
symptom: The user asks for the best smartwatch to use as a collector when the phone is out of range, without specifying a sensor initially.
evidence_quote: To use a watch as a collector, see the wiki here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/Patching-Android-Wear-devices-for-use-with-the-G5 The only watch to work as a collector " out of the box" is the SSW3. The others must be tweaked.
